hooks.command: cat "${MEMOIR_STORE}/HOT-MEMORY.md" 2>/dev/null; cat "${MEMOIR_STORE}/MEMORY.md" 2>/dev/null; cat "${MEMOIR_STORE}/triggers.md" 2>/dev/null; echo '--- memoir: startup context loaded ---'
hooks.commandWindows: if (Test-Path "$env:MEMOIR_STORE\HOT-MEMORY.md") { Get-Content "$env:MEMOIR_STORE\HOT-MEMORY.md" }; if (Test-Path "$env:MEMOIR_STORE\MEMORY.md") { Get-Content "$env:MEMOIR_STORE\MEMORY.md" }; if (Test-Path "$env:MEMOIR_STORE\triggers.md") { Get-Content "$env:MEMOIR_STORE\triggers.md" }; Write-Output '--- memoir: startup context loaded ---'

hooks.command: echo '--- memoir: session closing. Run /memoir:digest to maintain memory ---'
hooks.commandWindows: Write-Output '--- memoir: session closing. Run /memoir:digest to maintain memory ---'
